shortDescription: Marilyn Monroe wore a sheer crystal-adorned dress sketched by Bob Mackie to serenade President John F. Kennedy for his birthday in 1962. "Bob Mackie's Dazzling Legacy in 9 Outfits" at 5:40 p.m. ET on Sept. 14 incorrectly said that she serenaded President John F. Kennedy Jr.
